scope.inputs: two real pilot videos and two distinct queries

observation: Mixed-length queries fail before logits with upstream FlashAttention scatter/gather assertions, while exact same-length queries can run as a 2x16-frame batch. The successful batch used peak CUDA allocation 18.84 GiB, matched the two sequential runs within max absolute frame-score difference 0.00098, but took 18.22 s versus 4.61 s for two sequential requests.
implication: A restricted rank_batch API is technically correct for exact token-length buckets, but it is slower rather than faster on the current 24 GiB setup and is rejected as the burst-tail fix. Mixed-length batching remains unsupported.
source: interactive smoke command executed from scripts/benchmark_multi_gpu_workers.py environment
